key_insight: A multi-step LLM pipeline can turn clinical interview audio into MADRS item-level depression ratings to support structured assessment in clinical trials.
clinical_relevance: This could help clinicians standardize and interpret depression evaluations from interview-based trial assessments while keeping the results tied to the MADRS framework.
method: The transcript is mapped to the 10 MADRS symptom items.
The system estimates symptom severity and flags problematic ratings.
evidence_signal: In real clinical interviews, the pipeline achieved a strong overall correlation of 0.867 with expert ratings.
watch_item: Performance depends on high-quality interview transcripts and expert oversight, so it should support—not replace—clinical judgment in trial settings.
paper_title: The MADRS Pipeline: Supporting Depression Assessment in Clinical Trials
